item.title: Cost of Living in Keysborough Melbourne
item.description:
Rent in Keysborough tells one story. Groceries, coffee, and parking tell another. Here is the full picture.

Read our full Keysborough suburb guide for the bigger picture.

Is Keysborough Expensive?

Keysborough sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Keysborough, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.

item.title: Keysborough — History and How It's Changed
item.description:
Every neighbourhood has chapters. The most interesting ones for Keysborough involve post-war migration and renewal.

See our full Keysborough suburb guide for the current picture.

What Keysborough Was Originally

Before it was what you see today, Keysborough was agricultural land and market gardens. The original residents built the suburb’s foundation — the street grid, the housing stock, the community institutions that still exist in some form.

Like most of Melbourne, Keysborough’s history is inseparable from the broader story of a city that grew outward from the Yarra in waves. This suburb was settled when Melbourne needed it — whether for housing workers, accommodating families, or providing a retreat from the city centre.
